svg.title: Published starting budgets for a small Shopify Meta campaign
svg.desc: Shopify, Talk Shop and Meta describe different starting points. There is no single correct daily budget.

g.text: About 50 results in a week usually ends the learning phase. Not a dollar minimum.
They write $1 a day for impression billing, and recommend $5 a day for traffic or sales.
Their matrix starts at $5$10 a day before the shop has sales. That is their playbook.
Pick a number you can lose for 14 days. Then read Ads Manager, not a blog average.
